feed.title: Huntbase Hub
feed.subtitle: Threat hunts drafted from current public research, reviewed by a person, published as open hunt.md files.

entry.title: AD CS Certificate Abuse and Lateral Movement
entry.summary: An adversary is performing discovery against Active Directory Certificate Services to identify vulnerable templates (ESC1) or coercive authentication targets (ESC8), then obtaining certificates for privileged accounts to facilitate Kerberos authentication and data exfiltration.

entry.title: Teams Impersonation and Portable Runtime Execution
entry.summary: An intruder has impersonated help desk staff via Microsoft Teams to establish a remote support session and execute portable runtimes from a user-writable directory to begin system discovery.

entry.title: Endpoint Intrusion and Impact Chain
entry.summary: An intruder has gained a foothold using unauthorized remote management software or encoded scripts and is now attempting to dump credentials and inhibit system recovery.

entry.title: Identity and Cloud Access Anomalies
entry.summary: An intruder gained access via credential stuffing or MFA fatigue and established email collection or inhibited system recovery.

entry.title: AI-Scaled Social Engineering and Access
entry.summary: An intruder uses generative AI to produce high-volume tailored lures and trojanized repositories, subsequently deploying agentic frameworks like ARTEX for automated reconnaissance and persistence.

entry.title: AI-Enhanced C2 and Web Proxy Hijacking
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited PHP or Node.js vulnerabilities to deploy a Go-based implant that hides its command-and-control activity by hijacking AI API keys and using local proxies.

entry.title: AI-Driven NIK C2 Implant and Data Theft
entry.summary: An intruder has deployed the NIK C2 implant to harvest browser credentials and crypto wallets, potentially preparing to deploy screen-locking ransomware.

entry.title: Amatera Infostealer Initial Access and Persistence
entry.summary: An intruder has used social engineering to trick a user into executing PowerShell commands from the Run dialog, leading to the installation of the Amatera infostealer and persistent scheduled tasks.

entry.title: AI-Secret Theft and Ransomware Post-Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary is targeting hosts with AI development tools to scrape keychain secrets, moving laterally using discovery tools before exfiltrating data via Rclone and deploying ransomware like VYPR or Interlock.

entry.title: EDR Impairment and RMM-Driven Ransomware Execution
entry.summary: An adversary has established a foothold and is systematically disabling security controls via process termination and Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver (BYOVD) techniques to facilitate ransomware execution via RMM tools.

entry.title: NIK C2: Host Persistence and Evasion
entry.summary: An intruder has established persistence for the NIK C2 implant by placing masqueraded binaries in user profile paths and creating Registry Run keys to maintain an AI-augmented remote access session.

entry.title: Pre-Patch Web Runtime Exploitation
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited a zero-day vulnerability in an internet-facing web runtime during the four-day pre-patch window (Oct 17-21, 2026) to gain remote code execution, established botnet C2, and leveraged stolen credentials to persist via remote access services.

entry.title: LiteLLM Supply Chain Poisoning and Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary has installed a poisoned version of the LiteLLM library to establish persistence via Python startup files and exfiltrate host credentials.

entry.title: MDaemon Exploitation and Backdoor Lifecycle
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a public-facing MDaemon mail server or successfully phished a user, subsequently deploying a backdoor and using script-based decoys to evade security analysis by triggering AI safety guardrails.

entry.title: Development Pipeline Credential Abuse and Injection
entry.summary: An adversary has compromised developer credentials to harvest sensitive repository secrets and inject malicious code into private source code repositories, bypassing standard CI/CD protections.

entry.title: Rogue MDM and RMM Deployment
entry.summary: An attacker uses social engineering to enroll a device into an unauthorized MDM tenant, providing a persistent and privileged path to deploy a rogue RMM tool for remote access.

entry.title: Autonomous AI Retail Intrusions and Cloud Fraud
entry.summary: An adversary has compromised a retail employee account via social engineering and is now using an autonomous AI agent to conduct high-velocity reconnaissance and fraudulent gift card issuance within a sub-10-hour window.

entry.title: E-Commerce Edge Exploitation and API Abuse
entry.summary: Adversaries are exploiting e-commerce vulnerabilities like CosmicSting to gain initial access, followed by credential stuffing against customer APIs and the injection of digital skimmers into checkout flows.

entry.title: KeyDrift Framework Runtime Injection and Hooking
entry.summary: An adversary is using ptrace to inject malicious modules into the vdaemon process on a Cisco SD-WAN controller to intercept and exfiltrate control-plane keying material.

entry.title: Cisco SD-WAN Controller Service Tampering
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a Cisco SD-WAN authentication bypass to establish persistence by modifying runit service scripts and remounting the root filesystem as executable to facilitate malware deployment.

entry.title: Email-to-Ransomware Attack Correlation
entry.summary: An adversary has established initial access via a phishing email, resulting in an anomalous sign-in and subsequent mass file encryption by a non-system process.

entry.title: LiteLLM Remote Code Loading and Exfiltration
entry.summary: An adversary is using malicious Python startup hooks in a compromised package to execute a remote code loader and exfiltrate credentials from developer and production environments.

entry.title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 Supply Chain Compromise and Credential Harvesting
entry.summary: An intruder has distributed a compromised version of LiteLLM (1.107.0) that uses Python startup hooks to execute a credential harvester upon any Python invocation, targeting cloud, SSH, and browser secrets.

entry.title: MythicRatatoskr Mesh-Network Backdoor and Sandworm Handover
entry.summary: An adversary has established initial access via a scheduled task to deploy the MATCHWOK backdoor and subsequently installed the MythicRatatoskr backdoor, which uses the Yggdrasil mesh network for stealthy C2 communication.

entry.title: Entra ID Identity Hijack and Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary has replayed session tokens stolen through AiTM relays to register rogue devices and establish persistent MFA methods in the victim tenant.

entry.title: PHP2Shell RCE and Ransomware Execution
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited the php2shell unauthenticated RCE vulnerability on a host running an end-of-life PHP version to deploy ransomware and encrypt local data.

entry.title: InterSystems IRIS Cleartext Credential Exposure and Access
entry.summary: An attacker intercepts cleartext credentials from InterSystems IRIS superserver traffic on port 1972 to gain unauthorized access to the environment.

entry.title: Mobile Ingress and Device Code Hijacking
entry.summary: An adversary is targeting employees with mobile phishing links (smishing) that lure them into performing Entra ID device-code authentication, allowing the attacker to hijack cloud sessions from compromised or unmanaged mobile devices.

entry.title: ARTEX-Driven Cloud Persistence and Graph Exfiltration
entry.summary: An adversary is using agentic AI to perform high-velocity reconnaissance, credential additions, and data exfiltration within our Microsoft 365 environment after compromising a trusted application.

entry.title: Storm-0940 AI-Accelerated Authentication
entry.summary: An adversary is using agentic AI to automate high-volume password spraying and service principal authentication from a known infrastructure range to bypass interactive sign-ins.

entry.title: Post-RCE Persistence and Credential Theft
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited a PHP core vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618/109619) and is using the web worker context to harvest credentials or establish persistence via reverse shells and web shells.

entry.title: PHP2Shell: Web-to-Shell Staging
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting PHP core RCE vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618/19) to force web server processes to spawn shells or interpreters, which then perform system discovery and payload staging.

entry.title: Platform-as-a-Proxy Phishing and Input Abuse
entry.summary: An adversary is using trusted third-party retail or SaaS infrastructure to deliver social-engineering lures by injecting fraudulent helpline numbers into transactional notification fields or abusing public-facing registration forms.

entry.title: PHP Remote Code Execution and Shell Activity
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting the php2shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619) to execute unauthenticated code, which manifests as PHP worker processes spawning interactive shells or utility tools to retrieve secondary payloads.

entry.title: Amazon ClickFix Multi-stage Malware Infection
entry.summary: An adversary is deploying portable Node.js and IronPython interpreters to user-writable directories to execute obfuscated Doina loaders and Lumma infostealers.

entry.title: Amazon ClickFix Finger Utility Abuse
entry.summary: An adversary has lured a user to a spoofed Amazon page and pastejacked a command that uses finger.exe to download malicious payloads from a remote domain.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Execution and C2 Tunneling
entry.summary: An intruder is deploying AI-generated scripts for reverse shells and automated secret-scraping toolkits, using a centralized C2 infrastructure to coordinate post-exploitation activity.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Web Exploitation and Database Exfiltration
entry.summary: An intruder uses AI-generated reconnaissance to map web applications and performs targeted credential brute-forcing to exfiltrate databases.

entry.title: eMudhra Compromised Certificate and Go Runtime Audit
entry.summary: An adversary impersonates a trusted service or signs a malicious binary using a compromised eMudhra intermediate certificate in an environment that lacks strict revocation checking or runs a vulnerable Go runtime.

entry.title: SafePay Ransomware: Exfiltration and Impact
entry.summary: Adversaries have staged data using rare archival or cloud-sync tools and are now inhibiting system recovery by deleting shadow copies before executing a ransomware payload that renames user files to include the .SafePay extension.

entry.title: SafePay: Internal Discovery and Lateral Movement
entry.summary: An adversary is using legitimate administrative tools and scripts to enumerate network shares and move laterally via remote management protocols while disabling local security software.

entry.title: SafePay: External Access and Identity Consolidation
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a known edge vulnerability to gain a foothold and is consolidating control by creating administrative accounts and escalating local privileges via UAC bypass.

entry.title: Ad-Driven Phishing and Malware Delivery
entry.summary: An adversary is using fraudulent social media advertisements to lure users into phishing sites or trick them into installing remote access tools, identified by browser-originating traffic from social platforms followed by rare process execution.

entry.title: SafePay: Internal Enumeration and Lateral Movement
entry.summary: SafePay actors have established a foothold and are using repurposed administrative tools, credential dumpers, and anomalous RDP or SMB sessions to move laterally toward file shares.

entry.title: SafePay Ransomware: Perimeter Breach and Account Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited unpatched edge vulnerabilities or use VPN-based brute force to gain initial access, subsequently creating or elevating accounts to secure administrative persistence.

entry.title: Abuse of Flowise AI Orchestration Platforms
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting unauthenticated Flowise instances to harvest stored API credentials and hijack AI agents for internal network reconnaissance and financial data exfiltration.

entry.title: Virtualization Pivot and Host Encryption
entry.summary: The adversary has exploited a VPN gateway to breach the perimeter and is now pivoting to the virtualization layer to disable security controls and deploy ransomware via virtual disk manipulation.

entry.title: VPN Gateway Exploitation and Unauthorized Authentication
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited CVE-2026-0257 on a PAN-OS gateway to bypass authentication and establish a VPN session, identifiable by suspicious client hostnames, MAC addresses, or PoC-specific user agents.

entry.title: Zimbra Post-Exploitation and Cluster Exfiltration
entry.summary: An attacker who has compromised a Zimbra server is harvesting service credentials and moving laterally to peer nodes using the Zimbra SSH identity to exfiltrate mailbox data via specialized Go implants.

entry.title: Email Bombing and Identity Takeover Correlation
entry.summary: An attacker is using an email sign-up flood as a smokescreen to hide security alerts while they perform account takeovers and install remote access tools via tech support scams.
